recommendation: Keep this narrow source fix. Broader Transport narrative and boundary wording is tied to separate Transport workflow issues and should not be changed under FHIR-40491 without a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-40491 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core Transport and requested that Transport not bridge Request and Event workflow patterns. The final resolution was to adjust Transport.status to the event-oriented code list: preparation, in-progress, not-done, suspended, stopped, on-hold, completed, entered-in-error, and unknown.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3268 applied the issue. Commit c15815354fe243c45e239c355cbf41b8a5ba9153 changed source/transport/codesystem-transport-status.xml to the requested code list, and commit b2f79751ae37cc361c7cbcb9d0ce03a8d35f8d2d added entered-in-error and updated Transport.status.short. The application left not-done with a copy/paste definition saying Transport had been completed.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes transport as an OO resource, making source/transport/codesystem-transport-status.xml current build source. Related FHIR-39512 had already removed Transport.intent, Transport.priority, and request mappings so Transport is treated as an Event resource. OO minutes on 2024-11-19 record FHIR-40491 discussion, the vote, the then-current Transport.status list, and comparison with Event.status. A quoted Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed only the not-done concept definition in source/transport/codesystem-transport-status.xml to describe a transport event terminated before the main transport activity began. The requested status code list and StructureDefinition binding were otherwise already present.

related_jiras.note: Established Transport as an Event resource by removing Transport.intent, Transport.priority, and request mappings before FHIR-40491 aligned status codes.
Earlier Published Transport boundary text explains ServiceRequest/Task relationships and was not changed by this status-definition fix.
